question: Can any instrument available in this programme rank the 16 organizer-scored artifacts?

decisive_counterexamples.detail: p34-scatter-q50 and gemsdoe32-h33-h33-2-b2 both emit 37,654 dots; the scatter holds w = 0.1896 of SGMC-off-catalogue credit per dot, the field holds w = 0.1776 (7 % less), yet the live scores are 0.0778 and 0.2778 - a 3.6x inversion. SGMC credit density therefore has no power to discriminate placement quality at matched mass.

p13-lattice-s5-v2 is a blind 5-px lattice with no geological input; the LM instrument ranks it first of all 16 artifacts (0.4366) while its organizer score is third from the bottom (0.0904). The LM instrument has no ranking power (Spearman +0.10).

verdict: No instrument reproduced in this repository - the frozen all-prior SGMC gate, the 4-quadrant LM instrument, or the saturating live-score model with the locally defined credit density - can rank the scored artifacts, so none of them can promote a candidate. The H40 artifact stays HOLD, and the next session must validate a truth model by leave-one-out ranking of these 16 artifacts (target Spearman >= 0.8) before any emission decision is made.
next_session_requirement: build a truth model whose leave-one-out ranking of the 16 scored artifacts reaches Spearman >= 0.8 with no mass-only explanation, then re-emit; the public score record, not the surrogate credit density, is the only ground truth this programme has.
